meta.title: Move off The Events Calendar with Beacon Events
meta.description: A small site on The Events Calendar (venues, an organizer, categories, a weekly class entered as copies), switched off, with Beacon Events ready to import it.
meta.author: inmanjeffrey89-cell

options.blogname: Riverside Arts (moving off The Events Calendar)

steps.code:
<?php
// Seeds a small The Events Calendar site for the "try the move" Playground (blueprints/tec-move.json).
// Runs inside Playground after TEC is activated; dates are relative to today so they are always upcoming.
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
update_option( 'timezone_string', 'America/New_York' );
$tz  = 'America/New_York';
$v1  = tribe_venues()->set_args( array( 'venue' => 'Riverside Studio', 'address' => '120 Main St', 'city' => 'Hudson', 'state' => 'NY', 'zip' => '12534', 'country' => 'United States' ) )->create();
$v2  = tribe_venues()->set_args( array( 'venue' => 'Hudson Area Library', 'address' => '51 N 5th St', 'city' => 'Hudson', 'state' => 'NY', 'zip' => '12534', 'country' => 'United States' ) )->create();
$org = tribe_organizers()->set_args( array( 'organizer' => 'Riverside Arts Council', 'email' => 'hello@example.org' ) )->create();
$cat = array();
foreach ( array( 'Classes', 'Kids', 'Community' ) as $c ) { $t = wp_insert_term( $c, 'tribe_events_cat' ); $cat[ $c ] = is_wp_error( $t ) ? 0 : (int) $t['term_id']; }
$made = 0;
$ev = function ( $title, $start, $end, $venue, $c, $extra = array() ) use ( $tz, $org, $cat, &$made ) {
	$e = tribe_events()->set_args( array_merge( array( 'title' => $title, 'status' => 'publish', 'start_date' => $start, 'end_date' => $end, 'timezone' => $tz, 'venue' => $venue ? $venue->ID : 0, 'organizer' => $org->ID ), $extra ) )->create();
	if ( $e ) { wp_set_object_terms( $e->ID, array( $cat[ $c ] ), 'tribe_events_cat' ); $made++; }
	return $e;
};
// A weekly class entered one date at a time (free TEC has no repeats): Beacon offers to combine these.
$tue = strtotime( 'next tuesday', current_time( 'timestamp' ) );
for ( $i = 0; $i < 6; $i++ ) { $d = gmdate( 'Y-m-d', $tue + $i * WEEK_IN_SECONDS ); $ev( 'Drop-in Yoga', "$d 18:00:00", "$d 19:00:00", $v1, 'Classes' ); }
$sat = strtotime( 'next saturday', current_time( 'timestamp' ) );
for ( $i = 0; $i < 4; $i++ ) { $d = gmdate( 'Y-m-d', $sat + $i * WEEK_IN_SECONDS ); $ev( 'Family Story Hour', "$d 10:00:00", "$d 11:00:00", $v2, 'Kids' ); }
$fair = gmdate( 'Y-m-d', $sat + 2 * WEEK_IN_SECONDS );
$ev( 'Fall Craft Fair', "$fair 00:00:00", "$fair 23:59:59", $v1, 'Community', array( 'all_day' => true ) );
$jazz = gmdate( 'Y-m-d', $sat + WEEK_IN_SECONDS - DAY_IN_SECONDS );
$ev( 'Jazz Night with the Riverside Trio', "$jazz 19:30:00", "$jazz 21:30:00", $v1, 'Community', array( 'cost' => '15', 'url' => 'https://example.org/jazz-night-tickets' ) );
update_option( 'beacon_playground_seeded', $made );
